comparison.position: Integral DeltaNet保留fast delta state并新增其历史积分state；按key channel分别控制积分速度和当前/历史读出，积分state不反向改变delta更新。
comparison.tradeoff: KRA维护回归系数与后验协方差，遗忘时恢复可写不确定性；Integral维护delta与它的指数加权历史。两份state不意味着同一内容：协方差不是记忆副本，积分history也不执行KRA的相关key校正。现有L1不能比较语言召回收益。

analysis.title: Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration
analysis.body: KRA维护回归系数与后验协方差，遗忘时恢复可写不确定性；Integral维护delta与它的指数加权历史。两份state不意味着同一内容：协方差不是记忆副本，积分history也不执行KRA的相关key校正。现有L1不能比较语言召回收益。 第一式为GDN-2，KDA使用相同标量beta广播到erase/write；lambda与gamma均沿key channel，不是value行或一个全局标量。积分使用当前更新后的S。原文门rank128且初始化lambda≈1−gamma≈1/1024；本地缩小rank但保留同一可训练参数化。

question.question: 为什么不能把KRA的协方差P称为本文积分state？
question.answer: P描述相关key的后验不确定性并影响写入方向，X保存S的加权历史并只参与读取；语义和更新不同。
question.example: 教学例：在无新value时KRA遗忘可使P恢复，但X仍只是旧S历史的保留，不会变成写入增益矩阵。

comparison.position: Integral DeltaNet retains a fast delta state and a historical integral state, with key-channel integration/readout gates. The integral state does not feed back into the delta update.
comparison.tradeoff: KRA maintains regression coefficients and posterior covariance, restoring writable uncertainty under forgetting. Integral instead stores a delta state and its weighted history. Covariance is not a memory copy, and integral history does not implement KRA covariance-guided interference correction. Local L1 cannot compare language recall.

analysis.title: Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration
analysis.body: KRA maintains regression coefficients and posterior covariance, restoring writable uncertainty under forgetting. Integral instead stores a delta state and its weighted history. Covariance is not a memory copy, and integral history does not implement KRA covariance-guided interference correction. Local L1 cannot compare language recall. The first equation is GDN-2; broadcasting one beta across erase/write gives KDA. Lambda and gamma act on key channels, not value rows or one scalar. Integrate the updated S. The paper uses rank128 gates initialized near lambda=1-gamma=1/1024; the local rank is reduced but the trainable parameterization is retained.

question.question: Why is KRA covariance P not an integral state?
question.answer: P represents uncertainty and changes writes; X stores weighted S history and only participates in readout. Their semantics and updates differ.
question.example: Illustration:KRA forgetting can restore P without a new value,whereas X remains retained S history,not a write-gain matrix.

This is Nov24 overlap backfill with CPU L1 only; full experiments are terminally cost-deferred.

comparison.position: DeCo在runtime逐head估计主子空间，用Q侧和K侧一阶残差投影构造额外通道，让一个扩展QK点积带入两侧补偿；额外通道同样量化。
comparison.tradeoff: DualQuant仅从静态权重拟合row/column尺度并重缩放激活；DeCo每次attention从Q/K本身估计basis，补偿两边量化残差，不训练静态权重尺度。两者的浮点仿真都不等于packed低位CUDA kernel，更不能以A100浮点执行宣称原生FP4加速。

analysis.title: DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention
analysis.body: DualQuant仅从静态权重拟合row/column尺度并重缩放激活；DeCo每次attention从Q/K本身估计basis，补偿两边量化残差，不训练静态权重尺度。两者的浮点仿真都不等于packed低位CUDA kernel，更不能以A100浮点执行宣称原生FP4加速。 Eq6的sample是旋转后尚未量化的Q/K，各Gram独立trace归一化；sample为max(N/256,2r)，混合text/audio/video需分层抽样。Appendix Eq25每组用power-of-two全局scale、每16channel unsigned E4M3 block scale和E2M1值，额外通道不能保持高精度。attention除以原始sqrt(d)，不是扩展维数sqrt(d+2r)。

question.question: DeCo能直接替换DualQuant的权重尺度求解器吗？
question.answer: 不能。DualQuant优化静态weight重建的row/column尺度，DeCo纠正动态attention Q/K残差；对象和运行时机不同。
question.example: 教学例：两个prompt产生不同Q/K，DeCo需重估basis；静态weight尺度通常可复用。

comparison.position: DeCo estimates per-head principal subspaces at runtime and appends Q-side/K-side first-order residual projections as extra quantized channels of one expanded dot product.
comparison.tradeoff: DualQuant fits row/column scales from static weights and rescales activations. DeCo estimates a basis from current Q/K and compensates both rounding residuals. Neither floating simulation is a packed low-bit kernel; A100 floating execution cannot establish native FP4 acceleration.

analysis.title: DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention
analysis.body: DualQuant fits row/column scales from static weights and rescales activations. DeCo estimates a basis from current Q/K and compensates both rounding residuals. Neither floating simulation is a packed low-bit kernel; A100 floating execution cannot establish native FP4 acceleration. Eq6 uses raw rotated sampled Q/K,not already-rounded operands; normalize each Gram by its own trace. Sample max(N/256,2r),with stratification for mixed text/audio/video. Eq25 uses a power-of-two group scale,unsigned E4M3 block scales per16channels,and E2M1 values,including compensation channels. Divide scores by original sqrt(d),not sqrt(d+2r).

question.question: Can DeCo replace DualQuant's scale solver?
question.answer: No. DualQuant optimizes static-weight row/column reconstruction scales; DeCo corrects dynamic attention Q/K residuals.
question.example: Illustration:two prompts change Q/K and the estimated DeCo basis,while static weight scales can be reused.
